requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.
requirements.evidence: Built: half-s base piece at cell (0,-1), full bases at (0,0) and (1,-1). Spike spike:0#0,-1|0,0|1,-1 sits at the junction corner shared by cells (0,-1),(0,0),(1,-1). Drawer drawer:0#0,-1#cut (key n) sits on the cut face of the half base in cell (0,-1), the same cell the spike corner belongs to. check_build: ok, meshClash clear. Caveat: the configurator refused the drawer when the spike was at the corner under the south-half drawer (SPIKE_CLASH), so the drawer is on the north-facing key n variant, and the spike is at a corner of that cell rather than a corner the drawer solidly contacts. Only one drawer and one spike are present. LOOSE_BODY warning remains (joint bolts would lock it, not added).

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
